description: This file declares the class DobbySpecGenerator, which is responsible for generating runtime specifications in JSON format for containerized applications, including creating environment variables, mounts, plugins, and other configuration details. It includes external dependencies such as jsoncpp, application configuration, and runtime management interfaces.

classes.name: DobbySpecGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating container runtime specifications in JSON format, including environment variables, mounts, plugins, and other configuration details.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates the runtime specification JSON based on application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: createEnvVars
methods.description: Creates environment variables section for the JSON spec.

methods.name: createMounts
methods.description: Creates mount points section for the JSON spec.

methods.name: createRdkPlugins
methods.description: Creates RDK plugin configurations for the JSON spec.

methods.name: createAppServiceSDKPlugin
methods.description: Creates App Service SDK plugin configuration.

methods.name: shouldEnableGpu
methods.description: Determines if GPU should be enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: getSysMemoryLimit
methods.description: Retrieves system memory limit for the container.

methods.name: getGPUMemoryLimit
methods.description: Retrieves GPU memory limit for the container.

methods.name: getVpuEnabled
methods.description: Checks if VPU is enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: populateClassicPlugins
methods.description: Populates classic plugin configurations into the JSON spec.

methods.name: createFkpsMounts
methods.description: Creates FKPS mounts in the JSON spec.

methods.name: getWorkingDir
methods.description: Retrieves the working directory for the container.

methods.name: encodeURL
methods.description: Encodes URLs for use in the configuration.
